evidence.notes: Static Apex SOQL preserves a bare date literal when lowering bracket query syntax.
A static Apex SOQL date literal filters a local Date field.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLStaticDateLiteralTest { @isTest static void staticDateLiteralRuns() { Account target = new Account(Name = 'Target', RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 2, 15)); Account other = new Account(Name = 'Other', RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 2, 16)); insert new List<Account>{ target, other }; List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = 2026-02-15]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(target.Id, rows[0].Id); System.assertEquals('Target', rows[0].Name); } }
